name: Tanchou ni Chiru Hana
source:
July 1994, summer—

The protagonist's world.
The world of Nakiri Village.
Something was starting to unravel.
A daily life falling apart…
A routine that would come to an end…
A cruel god lurks in the shadows.
An impossible being in an unimaginable place.
Crack your head open,
Scream it out loud—
Who created this world?
Who allowed such existences?
Whose will is this?
The "happiness" they lost—
In a world where flowers no longer fall—
Can it be reclaimed once more?..

[Translated from [url=http://zipkreis.com/tancho/story.html]the official website[/url]]
